title: The Harbor-Keeper
description: Justin's original sea-being: the gentle keeper who guides ships into harbor through fog.

title: The Chart-Serpent
description: Justin's original sea-being: a serpent that swims the true course and lets navigators follow.

title: The Bell-Whale
description: Justin's original sea-being: a whale whose song rings like harbor bells across the water.

title: The Lantern-Squid
description: Justin's original sea-being: a squid that lights the deep with living lanterns for lost divers.

title: The Tide-Turtle
description: Justin's original sea-being: the turtle that carries the tide-tables on its shell.

title: The Storm-Shepherd
description: Justin's original sea-being: the shepherd who herds storms away from shipping lanes.

title: The Pearl-Dragon
description: Justin's original sea-being: the dragon that guards not gold but the ocean's memory of pearls.

title: The Quiet Current
description: Justin's original sea-being: the current itself, aware — the sea's own slow thought.
